FOR THE MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR I: BE it  therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This Act may be cited as the Amaradeva Aesthetic
and Research Centre Act, No. 27 of  2018.

2.
(1) There shall be established an aesthetic and research
centre  which  shall  be  called  the  Amaradeva  Aesthetic  and
Research Centre (hereinafter referred to as “the Centre”) and
also known as Amaradeva Asapuwa equipped with a research
laboratory, an archive, a library and a museum.
